title: The Aftermath of Anderlecht
author: Noor Fairweather
blurb: Ansel Marchetti, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
